messages:
Alex Kim: Quick weekly ops check — post-prefetch tuning for MeridianHealth. Wanted to surface the numbers and ask if we should push more prefetch to the next cohort.
Priya Rao: High level: cache "cold miss" rate down, effective cache hits up. I'll paste the short summary.
Diego Morales: tl;dr numbers pls so I can prep the renewal deck.
Priya Rao: 
```
week: +7d (rolling)
cache hits: 38.5% -> 44.7% (+6.2 pts)
avg batch size: 2.9 -> 3.4
p50 latency (inference): 95ms -> 110ms (small bump)
p95 latency: 420ms -> 480ms
error rate (5xx): 0.21% -> 0.18%
cost per 1k tokens: $0.74 -> $0.66 (-10.8%)
```
Priya Rao: Note — cost drop driven mainly by better KV cache reuse + slightly larger batch sizes.
Samir Patel: Nice. Any unexpected regressions? p95 up is concerning.
Alex Kim: We think p95 bump is due to occasional bigger batches hitting tail scheduling on a small subset of endpoints (tenant pinned to dedicated pool).
Diego Morales: Can we quantify how many requests were affected? Need to call that out to the account.
Priya Rao: Roughly 4% of requests saw >700ms; those were mostly multimodal routes with longer sequences. Non-multimodal stayed under 500ms.
Samir Patel: Actionable?
Alex Kim: Short term: add a conservative per-route max-batch-size override for the multimodal endpoints and enable async-prefetch on responses >4k tokens. Medium: adjust scheduling fairness in the pool.
cs-bot: Reminder: Weekly health digest posted to /cs-digest at 17:00 UTC.
Priya Rao: Proposed next steps: 1) Roll per-route max-batch-size (owner: Alex) 2) Schedule a 30m enablement call with MeridianHealth next Tues 16:00 PT (owner: Diego) 3) Add a rule to alert if p95 > 600ms for >3% of requests (owner: Samir).
Diego Morales: I can take the enablement call. Will update the runbook with the prefetch caveats.
Samir Patel: I'll set the alert and a temporary dashboard tile showing tail latencies and batch size distribution.
Alex Kim: I'll push the per-route override as a canary to their dedicated pool tomorrow morning; will post deploy logs here.
Priya Rao: For the renewal deck: highlight cost per 1k tokens improvement and show hit-rate trend. Diego, I'll drop a small chart and the blurb by EOD.
Diego Morales: Sounds good. One more ask: can we estimate monthly $ savings from the config changes? Even a rough order of magnitude helps.
Priya Rao: Rough estimate: current traffic -> ~$12k monthly savings if hit rate holds and batch size trend continues. Will refine tomorrow.
Alex Kim: Ok team — keep fixes minimal for the canary; if anything looks off we'll rollback and revert batch-size. :thumbsup:
Priya Rao: Thanks — tagging @MeridianHealth-primary (external) in the enablement invite once Diego confirms.
cs-bot: New task created: CS-3421 "MeridianHealth prefetch enablement" assigned to Diego Morales due 3 days.
